options: The practice of augmenting raw data with additional layers of value, such as tools, metadata and context, to make it easier to use, understand and act upon
Compressing data files to reduce storage costs
Encrypting data before it is sent over a network
Archiving old data in a separate warehouse
Converting data from one file format to another
questions.explanation: Data Wrapping augments raw data with tools, metadata and context, transforming it from a passive resource into an actionable asset.

questions.stem: In Data Wrapping, what does metadata include?
options: Only the file size of each dataset
Descriptions of data sources, timestamps, definitions, units of measurement and relationships between datasets
The visualisations built on the data
The passwords used to access the data
The names of the executives who use the data
questions.explanation: Metadata is the 'data about data', including descriptions of sources, timestamps, definitions, units of measurement and relationships between datasets.

questions.stem: Why is visualisation an important element of Data Wrapping?
options: Because it removes the need for metadata
Because it reduces data storage costs
Because humans process visual information much faster than raw data, aiding comprehension and decision-making
Because regulators require charts
Because it replaces documentation
questions.explanation: Humans process visual information much faster than raw data, so dashboards, charts and graphs are critical for comprehension and decision-making.

questions.stem: Which Data Wrapping element is implemented through APIs, web portals or dedicated applications integrated with workflows?
options: Metadata and Context
Data Quality Assurance
Governance and Compliance
Ease of Access
Documentation and Guides
questions.explanation: Ease of Access ensures data is readily available when and how users need it, implemented through APIs, web portals or dedicated applications.

questions.stem: In the Data Wrapping example, how does cleansing an e-commerce dataset of duplicate customer records help?
options: It makes the dashboards load faster
It reduces the need for governance
It eliminates the need for an API
It allows the data to be shared publicly
It ensures accurate customer lifetime value calculations
questions.explanation: Data Quality Assurance, including deduplication, builds trust; removing duplicate customer records ensures accurate customer lifetime value calculations.

questions.stem: Which formats are listed under the Documentation and Guides element of Data Wrapping?
options: Data dictionaries, user manuals, FAQs and quick start guides
Heatmaps, trend lines and charts
Audit trails, encryption and role-based access
APIs, web portals and applications
Timestamps, units and definitions
questions.explanation: Documentation and Guides take the form of data dictionaries, user manuals, FAQs and quick start guides, reducing the learning curve for users.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed as a key feature of the Governance and Compliance element of Data Wrapping?
options: Role-based access
Trend lines
Audit trails
Encryption
Adherence to standards like GDPR or HIPAA
questions.explanation: Governance and Compliance features are role-based access, audit trails, encryption and adherence to standards such as GDPR or HIPAA; trend lines belong to visualisation.

questions.stem: In the classroom scenario for Data Wrapping, what do teachers receive once raw student performance data is wrapped?
options: A printed list of raw scores
Access to the school's database server
A dashboard showing individual and class-wide performance trends, with insights suggesting targeted interventions
An encrypted archive of past results
A financial report on school spending
questions.explanation: By wrapping the data, teachers receive a dashboard of individual and class-wide trends and insights suggesting targeted interventions for struggling students.

questions.stem: In the retail business use case for Data Wrapping, what do predictive tools provide to C-Level leaders?
options: A list of employee salaries
Automatic price changes without human review
Raw daily sales figures only
Highlights of potential demand surges, enabling inventory optimisation
A replacement for the sales team
questions.explanation: In the retail use case, predictive tools highlight potential demand surges, enabling inventory optimisation alongside live dashboards and visual cues.

questions.stem: Which broader concepts is Data Wrapping said to align with?
options: Waterfall and Agile
OLTP and OLAP
Star and snowflake schemas
Batch and stream processing
Data As A Product (DAaP), Data As A Service (DAaS) and Data Stewardship
questions.explanation: Data Wrapping aligns with Data As A Product, Data As A Service and Data Stewardship, all focused on value-driven, outcome-oriented data solutions.
